name: Cook-Torrance BRDF
definition: A Physically Based Rendering (PBR) lighting model based on the Cook-Torrance BRDF that uses the microfacet surface model, conserves energy, and accurately represents real-world reflectance compared to Phong.
summary: The Cook-Torrance BRDF is a physically based lighting model using microfacets to accurately simulate real-world reflectance, energy conservation, and surface roughness.
